body:
## Summary
Argparse usage errors echoed mutated tokens, preventing the campaign supervisor from recognizing repeated failures. Normalize usage signatures and report the entire retained-stream replay while preserving the first hypothetical stop boundary. Campaign-tooling-only change; larger diff retains run logs and review evidence.

## Prior-Art & Ground Truth
`gh pr list --state open --search '1287' --json number,title` returned only this PR (#1361). Existing Tracker/signature/replay path was extended; no new runner or suite. Independent final artifact review confirmed supervisor code unchanged from native Codex-reviewed implementation through replay evidence commits. No broader claim of duplicate-free backlog audit.

## Proof of Done
- Native Agy implementation and independent Codex approval recorded in committed relay transcripts.
- `python3 -m pytest test/test_python_layer.py`: 21 passed after Python 3.9 failure was repaired using Python 3.13. See `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-11-07+GH-1356/retry-gate.log`; failed initial run retained. This generic suite does not test signature normalization.
- Actual replay CLI, exact command and input/output hashes: `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-11-07+GH-1356/REPLAY-PROCEDURE.md`, `replay-cli.json`, `provenance.jsonl`. 10,000 events, 23 usage signatures, first hypothetical stop 500, streak threshold 1,892. Baseline red control: 2,302 usage signatures, no streak threshold before 10,000.
- Normal docs push gates, no bypass. Hosted smoke evidence is commit-specific; promotion and canary are skipped for this PR, not executed passes.

## Governance & PDDA
Refs #1287 and #1356; leaves both open pending authorized landing and acceptance reconciliation. #1356 full batch remains incomplete. Active #1287 status row now describes verified replay and remaining landing. Suggested invocation roles corrected to Agy builder/Codex reviewer; attested transcript retained unchanged.

Historical generated transcripts and logs contain machine paths. No `check_machine_paths.py` was found in the bounded repository file search; no zero-violation claim is made. Existing PDDA hardcoded-path checks passed during normal docs publication. No new tests or gate machinery.

This is agent-assisted execution. Proposal-row reuse and approved-build gate retry were exercised; no-row pickup and cap-stall receipt-tail recovery were not. No merge requested by automation. Normalization is scoped to retained campaign error kinds; it is not universally token-free for arbitrary future argparse formats.
title: fix(GH-1287): normalize fuzz usage signatures with Batch 2 replay evidence
